About Nebula Painter

Nebula Painter is a constellation memory puzzle built on SpriteKit. Each of the 50 levels selects a real constellation chart — including Cassiopeia, Orion, Lyra, Pegasus, Hercules, Sagittarius, and 44 more — and shows a numbered mini star-map in the MEMORY panel for three seconds. When the panel fades, you must tap the glowing star anchors in the exact order shown. A correct step lights the anchor in cyan and draws a glowing line; a wrong step is marked in red during the review replay.

Levels are grouped into five phases. Phase 1 (L1–L10) uses 3–8 anchors on single-star patterns. Phase 2 (L11–L20) introduces binary-star concepts with up to 9 anchors. Phase 3 (L21–L30) adds dense nebula navigation with up to 10 anchors. Phase 4 (L31–L40) layers time-dilation mechanics with up to 10 anchors. Phase 5 (L41–L50) is the grandmaster challenge, culminating in a 15-anchor final artwork.

Star ratings reward efficient play: three stars for completing the order with no mistakes, two stars for one retry, one star for finishing. Progress and star ratings are saved locally on your device, so you can play fully offline at your own pace.

How to Play

1. Memorize

When a level starts, a MEMORY panel appears in the corner showing the constellation star-map with numbered anchors. Study the order for three seconds before the panel fades.

2. Tap in Order

Tap the glowing star anchors on the main nebula in the exact order shown. Each tap draws a glowing line from the previous anchor and places a numbered badge.

3. Review

After the final tap, the game replays your path. Correct steps glow cyan; wrong steps are marked red. Match the full memory order to clear the level.

4. Earn Stars

Complete the order with no mistakes for three stars. Retry once for two stars. Finish on a later attempt for one star. Unlock the next level by clearing the current one.

5. Explore 50 Levels

Progress through five phases: single-star patterns, binary-star concepts, nebula density zones, time dilation, and grandmaster constellation artwork up to 15 anchors.

6. Pause Anytime

Tap the pause button to open a panel with Resume, Restart, and Menu options. Your progress is saved locally, so you can stop and continue later offline.

Support

How do I play?

Watch the MEMORY panel for the numbered star order, then tap the glowing anchors on the nebula in that exact order to trace the constellation.

Does it need internet?

No. Nebula Painter is an offline single-player game with all progress saved locally on your device.

Need help?

After release, contact support through the Nebula Painter App Store product page.
